risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and quantitatively supported, including sales, earnings, restructuring, impairment, and cash-flow figures. Risk factors include declining volumes, weak industrial demand, regional sluggishness, divestitures, restructuring charges, Russia-related losses, and inflation, although management presents resilience and improved profitability. Some segment commentary relies on broad directional descriptions and offsetting-cause language rather than fully quantified drivers.
